name: proj4j test fixture: a triangle referring to a vertex that does not exist
description: Not a real model. Structurally a valid triangulation file except that the single triangle names vertex 9 of a three-vertex list, which is how a truncated or hand-edited model most often breaks. It exists so that a model that resolves but does not parse is proved to be refused at construction with a message naming the problem, rather than becoming a transform that returns its input.
